title: Heterophenomenology is neutral and is standard scientific practice

statements.text: Heterophenomenology is the organization of the data, a catalogue of what must be explained, not a theory. It is the method psychophysicists and cognitive psychologists already use, and no one has yet pointed to data it cannot reach. Its neutrality lets deflationary theories compete, on which consciousness is more like stage magic than black magic.

sources.quote: Heterophenomenology is the beginning of a science of consciousness, not the end.
Nobody has yet pointed to any variety of data that are inaccessible to heterophenomenology.
consciousness is more like stage magic than black magic, requiring no revolution in either physics or metaphysics
